blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: We present $μ$MPC, a fast model predictive control (MPC) framework that reduces online computation using learned Koopman-linearized dynamics. By precomputing finite-horizon control-to-output maps, $μ$MPC eliminates lifted-state trajectories, yielding an action-only Koopman-Compiled QP (KC-QP) with $Hn_u$ decision variables, independent of lifted dimension. A fixed, precomputed primal operator enables efficient primal-dual iterations using only matrix-vector products and projections, accommodating changing goals and constraints without refactorization. This efficiency also enables control-aware dynamics learning through differentiable KC-QPs in the training loop and batched DAgger-style data aggregation. $μ$MPC achieves solve times as low as $23μ$s on a desktop CPU and 24 ms onboard a 168 MHz Crazyflie microcontroller. It scales to 4096D quadruped control in under 5 ms, visual planning with 2048D world models in 0.4 ms, and collision-aware planning for 200 quadrotors at over 30 Hz on the GPU. Across these benchmarks, $μ$MPC achieves up to $108\times$ faster constrained MPC and $1907\times$ faster visuomotor planning than competing methods.
blocks.zh: 我们提出了$μ$MPC,这是一个快速模型预测控制(MPC)框架,它利用学到的科普曼线性动态减少在线计算. 通过预算有限视距控制到输出的地图,$μ$MPC消除了被升起的状态轨迹,产生一个只动作的克普曼编译QP(KC-QP),其中包含$Hn_u$决定变量,独立于被升起的尺寸. 一个固定的、预先计算的初级操作员能够使用只使用矩阵媒介产品和预测的高效的初级-双重迭代,在不重构的情况下适应不断变化的目标和限制。 这种效率还使得在训练循环中通过不同的KC-QP和分批Dagger式的数据汇总来进行具有控制意识的动态学习. $μ$MPC在桌面CPU上实现23μ$s的解析时间,在168MHz Crazyflie微控制器上实现24ms. 它以5ms以下的分级为4096D四重控制,以0.4ms的可视化规划为2048D世界型号,并用超过30Hz的GPU对200个四重机进行相撞感知规划. 在这些基准中,微元MPC达到108\times的MPC受限速度快,而1907\times的Vuomotor规划速度快于相竞方法。

blocks.en: I Introduction
blocks.zh: 一. 导言

blocks.en: Optimal control of complex robotic systems requires expressive dynamics models and real-time solvers for deployment, which is particularly difficult for resource-constrained and high-dimensional systems. Embedded aerial robots face strict compute, memory, and power budgets [ 1 , 2 ] ; whole-body legged control requires high-dimensional real-time optimization [ 3 , 4 ] ; visuomotor planning relies on learned world models with thousands of latent states [ 5 , 6 ] ; and multi-agent systems require many concurrent optimizations [ 7 , 8 ] . Controllers must also plan over long horizons, react rapidly to observations, and satisfy complex constraints. Nonlinear model predictive control (MPC) addresses these requirements, but its computational cost grows with problem dimension, horizon length, and constraint complexity. Despite advances in sparsity exploitation, factorization caching, and GPU parallelism [ 4 , 3 ] , real-time deployment remains challenging.
blocks.zh: 对复杂机器人系统的优化控制需要表现动力模型和部署的实时解析器,这对于资源受限和高维度的系统尤为困难. 嵌入式航空机器人面临严格的计算,内存,和动力预算[1,2];全机脚部控制需要高维实时优化[3,4];粘接机规划依赖于具有上千个潜伏状态的有学识的世界模型[5,6];多剂系统需要许多同时优化[7,8]. 主计长还必须制定长期计划,对观测作出迅速反应,并满足复杂的制约。 非线性模型预测控制(MPC)满足了这些要求,但其计算成本随着问题维度,地平线长度和约束性复杂性而增加. 尽管在Sparsity开发、因子化缓冲和GPU并行性[4,3]方面取得了进展,但实时部署仍然具有挑战性。

blocks.en: This computational challenge is particularly pronounced for learned dynamics and world models. While these models can capture complex dynamics from high-dimensional observations, planning often requires repeated computationally-expensive evaluations of candidate action sequences through the learned dynamics [ 5 , 9 , 10 ] . One approach to reducing this cost is via Koopman linearization , which learns dynamics that are linear in a lifted space, yielding an affine dependence of finite-horizon predictions on the control sequence [ 11 ] that simplifies both prediction and trajectory optimization. However, nonlinear constraints can still require iterative linearization and expensive matrix refactorizations, limiting the computational benefits. This motivates an MPC framework that moves expensive computations offline while allowing goals and constraints to be updated efficiently online.
blocks.zh: 这一计算挑战对于学习到的动态和世界模型来说尤为突出。 虽然这些模型能够从高维度观测中捕捉到复杂的动态,但规划往往需要通过所学到的动态对候选动作序列进行反复的计算成本评价[5,9,10]. 降低这一成本的一种方法是通过克普曼线性化(Koopman lineization),它学习了被升空空间中的线性动态,产生有限视距预测对控制序列的亲缘依赖[11],从而简化了预测和轨迹优化. 然而,非线性限制仍然需要迭代线性化和昂贵的矩阵重构,限制了计算效益. 这促使一个MPC框架将昂贵的计算下线,同时使目标和制约因素能够有效地在线更新。

blocks.en: Another challenge is learning dynamics models that are suitable for control rather than prediction alone. Conventional Koopman dynamics learning emphasizes state-prediction accuracy [ 12 ] , but low prediction error may not translate to high control performance. Moreover, training on fixed demonstrations neglects controller-induced distribution shifts, potentially degrading prediction accuracy at inference time. Differentiable MPC offers a way to address these limitations [ 13 ] by incorporating the learned Koopman dynamics into the MPC optimization during training, enabling direct supervision of control performance and generating training data arising from controller-induced state distributions. However, repeatedly solving and differentiating through MPC problems can be prohibitively expensive during training.
blocks.zh: 另一个挑战是学习适合控制而不是仅靠预测的动态模型。 常规Koopman动态学习强调状态预测精度[12],但低预测误差可能不会转化为高控制性能. 此外,关于固定演示的培训忽略了控制器引起的分布变化,在推断时间可能降低预测准确性。 可区分的MPC提供了一个解决这些局限性的方法[13],在培训期间将所学得的Koopman动态纳入MPC优化,从而能够直接监督控制性能并生成控制器所引发状态分布所产生的培训数据. 然而,通过MPC问题反复解决和区分,在培训期间费用可能过高。

blocks.en:
To address these challenges, we present μ \mu MPC, an MPC framework for nonlinear systems that exploits learned Koopman-linearized dynamics to formulate Koopman-Compiled Quadratic Programs (KC-QPs) that can be solved in microseconds. We develop a tailored primal-dual solver that precomputes a fixed primal operator offline, reducing online constrained optimization to efficient matrix-vector products and projections. This operator can be reused across changing constraints, goals, and MPC steps, substantially reducing online computation. The efficiency of KC-QPs also enables scalable control-aware learning: we solve batches of KC-QPs in parallel, evaluate the resulting control performance under the original nonlinear dynamics, and differentiate through the optimization to train Koopman representations directly for control performance rather than prediction accuracy alone. Furthermore, fast batched KC-QP solves enable DAgger-style on-policy data aggregation, improving coverage of controller-induced state distributions and mitigating inference-time distribution shift. Together, this scalable learning of high-dimensional Koopman representations tailored to closed-loop control enables microsecond-scale online MPC.
Our contributions are: • μ \mu MPC exploits the linear structure of learned Koopman dynamics to eliminate state variables and formulate MPC as an action-only QP (KC-QP). We precompute a fixed primal operator offline, enabling fast, “precompiled” primal-dual iterations using only matrix-vector products and projections, even as goals and constraints change, without requiring online matrix refactorization. • We exploit the compact, parallelizable structure of KC-QPs to train the Koopman dynamics to produce MPC control sequences that match expert demonstration data, by differentiating through the optimization. Batched KC-QP solves also enable fast DAgger-style data aggregation, reducing controller-induced distribution shift. • We demonstrate μ \mu MPC across embedded, high-dimensional, multi-agent, and visual control. Our solver achieves MPC runtimes as low as 23 μ \mu s on Dubins car and quadrotor systems, solves H = 75 H=75 MPC onboard a resource-limited Crazyflie microcontroller in 24 ms, and performs 4096-dimensional quadruped control in under 5 ms. We further demonstrate real-time collision-aware multi-agent planning for 200 quadrotors, with hardware validation on a system of seven differential-drive robots. For visual control, we train 2048D linear world models enabling sub-millisecond planning, outperforming evaluated baselines on navigation and bimanual rope manipulation, with hardware cube-manipulation validation.

blocks.en: II Related Work
blocks.zh: 二. 相关工作

blocks.en:
Koopman MPC and fast optimal control. Koopman methods lift nonlinear dynamics into approximately linear coordinates for linear MPC [ 11 , 14 ] , with recent extensions to robotic systems [ 15 , 16 ] .
Existing formulations retain important online computational overhead: [ 11 ] employ a prescribed lifting basis, which may not adequately represent nonlinear costs and constraints in a form amenable to efficient quadratic programming; [ 17 ] condense Koopman MPC but specialize to input constraints; and [ 18 ] eliminates high-dimensional observables but keeps physical states and controls as decision variables under box structure.
More broadly, fast MPC exploits sparsity, condensing, cached factorizations, and specialized solvers [ 19 , 20 , 1 ] , while recent GPU methods parallelize dynamics and optimization [ 3 , 4 , 2 ] .
In contrast, μ \mu MPC compiles Koopman dynamics into an action-only KC-QP. For fixed horizon, quadratic weights, and primal regularization, its precomputed primal operator remains reusable across changing goals and constraints, reducing online constrained optimization to matrix–vector products and projections without refactorization.
blocks.zh:
Koopman MPC和快速优化控制. Koopman方法将非线性动力学提升到线性MPC[11,14]的约线性坐标上,最近对机器人系统的扩展[15,16].
现有配方保留了重要的在线计算间接费用:[11]采用规定的起重基,这种起重基可能不足以代表非线性成本和制约,其形式适合高效的四极编程;[17]凝聚了Koopman MPC,但专门用于输入限制;[18]消除高维可观测,但将物理状态和控制作为决定变量置于框结构之下。
更广义地说,快的MPC利用了sparsity,c凝聚,缓存等分化,以及专门的解析器[19,20,1],而最近的GPU方法将动态和优化[3,4,2]相平行.
相形之下,μ \mu MPC 将 Koopman 动态编译为只动作的 KC- QP. 对于固定的地平线、四重和初始化,其预估的初始操作者在不断变化的目标和制约因素中仍然可以重复使用,减少了在线限制优化矩阵-媒介产品和预测而不进行再设计。

blocks.en:
Differentiable control learning. Differentiable optimization and MPC support end-to-end learning through constrained control [ 13 , 21 , 22 , 23 ] .
KCPO [ 24 ] combines deep Koopman dynamics with differentiable MPC under hard box control constraints.
We instead differentiate an efficient control-recovery KC-QP that directly supervises the finite-horizon control response, then pair it with DAgger-style on-policy aggregation.
This efficiently targets control relevant model error and controller-induced distribution shift without differentiating through a full expensive nonlinear MPC solve.
blocks.zh:
差别相能相能相能相能相能相能相能相能相能相能相. 可分化优化和MPC通过受限控制支持端到端学习[13,21,22,23].
KCPO [24] 在硬盒控制限制下,将深层克普曼动态与可分化的MPC结合.
相反,我们区分了一种高效的控制回收KC-QP,它直接监督有限范围的控制反应,然后将其与Dagger式的政策汇总联系起来。
这种高效的目标控制了相关的模型出错和由控制器引发的分布转移,而没有通过一个完全昂贵的非线性MPC解决方案加以区分.

blocks.en:
World models and latent planning. World models plan through learned latent dynamics [ 25 , 26 , 27 , 5 , 9 ] .
DINO-WM and LeWorldModel optimize action sequences through repeated latent prediction; Fast-LeWM parallelizes prediction but retains CEM search [ 10 ] ; learned planners instead amortize refinement from imagined rollouts [ 28 ] . Historically, these world model dynamics have been represented with high-dimensional nonlinear functions that are expensive to evaluate. μ \mu MPC instead learns linear world model dynamics, enabling compiliation of the full-horizon response into a compact KC-QP for sub-millisecond planning, avoiding repeated latent rollouts at planning time while permitting explicit linearized state/task constraints and action bounds.
blocks.zh:
世界模式和潜在规划。 世界模型计划通过学到的潜在动力[25、26、27、5、9]。
DINO-WM和LeWorldModel通过再三潜伏预测优化动作序列; Fast-LEWM 将预测平行,但保留CEM搜索[10]; 学习型规划者将所想象的推出的完善分期摊还[28]. 历史上,这些世界模型动态一直被以高维非线性功能来代表,这些功能是昂贵的来评价的. μ\mu MPC转而学习线性世界模型动力学,使得全视距响应能够被配合成一个紧凑的KC-QP来进行次毫秒规划,避免在规划时重复潜在的推出,同时允许明确的线性状态/任务限制和行动界限.

blocks.en: IV Method
blocks.zh: 四. 方法

blocks.en: Our method proceeds in four stages. First, we learn a nonlinear lifting with control affine linear latent dynamics. Second, we compile its finite-horizon response into precomputed maps and eliminate the latent trajectory from the optimization variables. Third, we solve the resulting action-only KC-QP with a primal–dual method whose primal update operator is fixed for a given model, horizon, objective, and primal regularization, and can therefore be precomputed offline and reused as constraints are relinearized online. Finally, we train the representation with differentiable QP for direct control supervision, and DAgger aggregation to improve its finite-horizon control behavior on the distribution induced by its own controller.

blocks.en: To mitigate controller-induced distribution shift, we use DAgger-style aggregation. At each epoch, the finite-horizon tracking QP used for control-recovery supervision generates control sequences that are executed in simulation. The resulting trajectories are added to a bounded replay buffer and mixed with original demonstrations, adapting the model to controller-visited states while retaining expert data.
blocks.zh: 为了缓解控制器引起的分布转移,我们采用Dagger式的聚合. 在每个时代,用于控制-回收监督的有限-视距跟踪QP产生在模拟中执行的控制序列. 由此产生的轨迹被添加到有边框的回放缓冲中并被与原始演示相混合,在保留专家数据的同时将模型适应控制器访问状态.

blocks.en: We evaluate whole-body quadruped control using a 4096-dimensional Koopman model of the 61-dimensional robot state, comprising floating-base pose and velocity, joint states, foot positions, and ground-reaction forces, with 12 joint-torque inputs. The three-hidden-layer, width-512 GELU encoder is trained for 100 epochs with batch size 2500 and 55-step rollouts. Fixed base height and commanded linear and angular velocities are also tracked. We compare against MPX’s primal–dual iLQR [ 3 ] and GPU-ADMM SQP [ 4 ] using identical reference generation and torque limits. blocks.en: We evaluate all planners on pixel-based bimanual rope manipulation and Reacher [ 6 , Fig. 2c-d] using Koopman-linearized latent world models for planning and control. We evaluate the efficacy of our planner using random workspace start–goal pairs, rather than LeWM [ 9 ] and Fast-LeWM’s [ 10 ] 25-step same-trajectory goal sampling. Images are encoded by a custom ViT into a 12-dimensional embedding, augmented with first- and second-order differences to form s t = [ e t , Δ ​ e t , Δ 2 ​ e t ] ∈ ℝ 36 s_{t}=[e_{t},\Delta e_{t},\Delta^{2}e_{t}]\in\mathbb{R}^{36} , and lifted to a 2048-dimensional Koopman model with linear dynamics. blocks.en: VI CONCLUSION
blocks.zh: 六. 结论

blocks.en: We presented μ \mu MPC, a framework that combines scalable Koopman dynamics learning with fast constrained MPC. By compiling finite-horizon predictions into action-only KC-QPs with a reusable primal operator, μ \mu MPC reduces online primal-dual optimization to matrix-vector products and projections, invariant under changing goals and constraints. Lightweight differentiable control-recovery QPs enable fast, batched supervision and scalable DAgger-style data aggregation, directly training dynamics for finite-horizon control. Across experiments, μ \mu MPC achieves millisecond-scale whole-body control with 4096-dimensional Koopman models, submillisecond planning with 2048-dimensional linear world models, long horizon MPC onboard Crazyflie MCU, and real-time planning for 200 quadrotors.
blocks.zh: 我们提出了μ \ mu MPC, 这个框架结合了可扩展的 Koopman 动态学习和快速受限 MPC. μ\mu MPC通过将有限视距预测汇编成具有可再使用的初始操作器的只行动KC-QP,降低了在线初始双向优化到矩阵-媒介产品和预测,在不断变化的目标和限制下变化不定. 轻量级不同可控回收QP能使快速分批监管和可扩展Dagger式数据聚合成为可能,直接为有限范围控制训练动态. 通过实验,μ\mu MPC以4096维的克普曼模型实现毫秒的全身控制,以2048维的线性世界模型实现亚米立秒规划,在Crazflie MCU上实现长地平线MPC,并实时规划出200个四相机.

blocks.en: Future work should focus on principled model selection and improved constraint handling. Our reported encoder capacities, lifted dimensions, and training horizons were selected through empirical tuning and retraining, motivating scaling laws relating these choices to prediction and closed-loop performance. In very demanding cases, fixed-budget solves may retain residual constraint violations, incorporating constraints into training could improve constraint response with fewer primal-dual iterations. Current model-error margins also remain empirical rather than formally calibrated.
blocks.zh: 今后的工作应侧重于原则性模式选择和改进制约处理。 我们所报告的编码能力、提高的维度和培训前景是通过经验调整和再培训选定的,从而激励将这些选择与预测和闭路性能相联系的扩大法律。 在非常困难的情况下,固定预算的解决可能保留了剩余的违反限制规定的情况,将限制规定纳入培训可以减少初步重复,从而改进对限制的反应。 目前的模型-误差幅度也仍然是经验性的,而不是正式校准的。
